summary: Our project is an **AI-powered Mars navigation system** designed to make exploration of the Martian surface safer and more efficient. Using 3D terrain maps and artificial intelligence, the system identifies potential hazards such as craters, steep slopes, and rocky terrain. It allows astronauts to select a starting point and destination, then recommends multiple routes based on safety, distance, and resource efficiency. Our goal is to **reduce exploration risks, improve navigation, and support future human missions to Mars.**
